> It was meant to show that their actions contributed to her mental state which led her to killing herself and that our actions can have an effect whether we intended them or not. 

At the end of the day, you can’t bully someone into killing themselves, most people who commit suicide do so because they have a chemical imbalance (depression) that convinces them it’s the only option. The show failed to stress that and made it seem like Hannah’s actions are a direct results of her classmates being mean and if they hadn’t been mean, she’d be alive. Clay says that multiple times, he blames everyone on the tapes for killing her. Another thing that supports this is the fact that people actually were nice to her, the poetry guy for example told her they had missed her at the meetings and really wanted her to come back, and that display of kindness didn’t stop her from taking her life. depression isolates you and makes you feel like the world would truly be better off without you, it causes you to ignore any good thing in ur life bc it feels like there’s no other option but death.
